answer: A farm can rehearse the comet and rehearse the atlas, but it cannot rehearse the dawn, because a year will not rehearse. Getting caught costs the farm a 25% cut on 131274 POA of stakes, and the panel catches farms most of the time. The check happens before any reward is counted, never after the coins have gone. One proof settles it, and it reads Tin packer solder warrant soldered into the plating vat, spelled out in full as each solder is a soldering record witnessed by the master tinsmith.
